body:
what happened

The press and the file came out right on the deployed page (the probe handed over `progressive-chat.prgrssv` from the row's plate), but the plate itself stood blank: an anchored `nodes::Text` with no `maxWidth` of its own is laid out to none, and its words end up where nothing shows them -- the same way the *Read the design* plate has stood blank all along (not touched here: its own call is its own).

what this says

The archive's label now gets laid out the way every other label of the settings page does -- a `maxWidth` first, then where it stands, and `visible` said for good measure. One call in `say_about`, nothing else moves.
title: the words on the archive plate laid out as the page lays out its words
